standards.name: CDISC Operational Data Model (ODM)
standards.abstract: Operational Data Model (ODM) is a vendor‑neutral, platform‑independent XML format for exchanging and archiving clinical and translational research data and their associated metadata, administrative data, reference data, and audit information. The examples provided are an ODM snapshot of the CDISC Glossary controlled terminology (XML representation of codelists and enumerated items). Recording modality: structured XML files representing study metadata and enumerated controlled-terminology items.

classification.rationale: ODM is an XML exchange format that encodes structured metadata (Study, GlobalVariables, MetaDataVersion, CodeList, EnumeratedItem, etc.) and controlled terminology in clearly identifiable fields and attributes. This maps naturally to a metadata table representation (fields with types and possible values).

Purpose.name: Purpose / Description
Purpose.descr: High-level description of what ODM is used for.
Purpose.evidence: "ODM is a vendor-neutral, platform-independent format for exchanging and archiving clinical and translational research data, along with their associated metadata, administrative data, reference data, and audit information. ODM facilitates the regulatory-compliant acquisition, archival and exchange of metadata and data. It has become the language of choice for representing case report form content in many electronic data capture (EDC) tools."

FileOID.descr: Unique identifier for the ODM file.

Granularity.name: Granularity
Granularity.descr: Scope/granularity of the file content (e.g., Metadata).

CreationDateTime.name: CreationDateTime
CreationDateTime.descr: Timestamp when the file was created.

ODMVersion.name: ODMVersion
ODMVersion.descr: Version of the ODM specification used.

Originator.name: Originator
Originator.descr: Person or team that generated the file.

SourceSystem.name: SourceSystem
SourceSystem.descr: System that provided the source content.

nciodm:Context.name: nciodm:Context
nciodm:Context.descr: Context annotation from the NCI/EVS extension.

nciodm:ControlledTerminologyVersion.name: nciodm:ControlledTerminologyVersion
nciodm:ControlledTerminologyVersion.descr: Version of the controlled terminology used.

Study.OID.name: Study OID (Study element)
Study.OID.descr: Unique identifier for the Study element.

GlobalVariables.StudyDescription.name: GlobalVariables:StudyDescription
GlobalVariables.StudyDescription.descr: Short description of the study content.

GlobalVariables.ProtocolName.name: GlobalVariables:ProtocolName
GlobalVariables.ProtocolName.descr: Protocol name associated with the study/file.

MetaDataVersion.OID.name: MetaDataVersion OID
MetaDataVersion.OID.evidence: <MetaDataVersion OID="CDISC_CT_MetaDataVersion.Glossary.2025-09-26" Name="CDISC Glossary Controlled Terminology" Description="CDISC Glossary Controlled Terminology, 2025-09-26">

CodeList.OID.name: CodeList OID
CodeList.OID.descr: Identifier for a CodeList element (controlled terminology list).
CodeList.OID.evidence: <CodeList OID="CL.C67497.CDISC Glossary" Name="CDISC Glossary" DataType="text" nciodm:ExtCodeID="C67497">

CodeList.nciodm:ExtCodeID.name: CodeList nciodm:ExtCodeID
CodeList.nciodm:ExtCodeID.descr: External code identifier from NCI/EVS extension.

CodeList.Description.TranslatedText.name: CodeList Description TranslatedText
CodeList.Description.TranslatedText.evidence: <TranslatedText xml:lang="en">The terminology of the Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) glossary.</TranslatedText>

EnumeratedItem.510(k).CodedValue.name: EnumeratedItem CodedValue (example: 510(k))
EnumeratedItem.510(k).CodedValue.descr: A codelist item coded value and its annotations (example).

EnumeratedItem.510(k).CDISCDefinition.name: EnumeratedItem CDISCDefinition (510(k))
EnumeratedItem.510(k).CDISCDefinition.descr: Definition text for the enumerated item 510(k).
EnumeratedItem.510(k).CDISCDefinition.evidence: <nciodm:CDISCDefinition>510(k). Premarket Notification (PMN) required for certain medical devices. See http://www.fda.gov/cdrh/510khome.html.</nciodm:CDISCDefinition>

EnumeratedItem.510(k).PreferredTerm.name: EnumeratedItem PreferredTerm (510(k))
EnumeratedItem.510(k).PreferredTerm.descr: Preferred human-readable term for the enumerated item 510(k).

EnumeratedItem.abbreviation.CDISCDefinit.name: EnumeratedItem CDISCDefinition (abbreviation)
EnumeratedItem.abbreviation.CDISCDefinit.descr: Definition text for the enumerated item abbreviation.
EnumeratedItem.abbreviation.CDISCDefinit.evidence: <nciodm:CDISCDefinition>A set of letters that are drawn from a word or from a sequence of words and that are used for brevity in place of the full word or phrase. NOTE: An abbreviation is NOT pronounced as a word, but each letter is read in sequence (e.g., NIH). Compare to acronym.</nciodm:CDISCDefinition>

EnumeratedItem.accrual.CDISCDefinition.name: EnumeratedItem CDISCDefinition (accrual)
EnumeratedItem.accrual.CDISCDefinition.evidence: <nciodm:CDISCDefinition>The accumulation or increase in the number of study subject enrolled over time. NOTE: Accrual is often conflated with enrollment but there is a semantic distinction in that accrual represents the rate of subject enrollment. [After Schroen AT, Petroni GR, Wang H, Thielen MJ, Gray R, Benedetti J, Wang XF, Sargent DJ, Wickerham DL, Cronin W, Djulbegovic B, Slingluff CL Jr. Achieving sufficient accrual to address the primary endpoint in phase III clinical trials from U.S. Cooperative Oncology Groups. Clin Cancer Res. 2012 Jan 1;18(1):256-62.] See also target enrollment.</nciodm:CDISCDefinition>

standards.notes: Extraction limited to the provided CDISC web pages and the supplied ODM XML artifact. The fields above are extracted from the ODM XML header and the contained MetaDataVersion/CodeList/EnumeratedItem entries in the artifact; many additional ODM elements and attributes exist in the full ODM specification but were not present in the provided materials.
